source: The memory hierarchy is the hardware substrate beneath those differences. System-level techniques such as sharding, checkpointing, offloading, continuous batching, and KV paging decide which bytes are present and when. Kernels decide how efficiently each active working set moves through the ZXNAME0000XZ.
zh: 内存层次结构是这些差异背后的硬件基础。分片、检查点、卸载、连续批处理和 KV 分页等系统级技术决定存在哪些字节以及何时存在。内核决定每个活动工作集在 ZXNAME0000XZ 中移动的效率。
